name: IMBA
notes: /events redirects to a bare homepage; the real listing is /seminars-events (shared IMP/IMBA/GMI Vienna BioCenter seminar calendar, same events as the imp scraper under different ids). Site is fronted by Cloudflare and ~20-30% of requests 403 with a JS challenge even from a real browser UA over plain HTTP/1.1 - scrape.py retries every fetch up to 10x with backoff, which is why a full run takes 1-2 minutes. Discovers events by walking the mini-calendar month-by-month (each page's 'next' link carries its own TYPO3 cHash, arbitrary month/year query combos 404 without one), then fetches each event's detail page for the authoritative 'Date: ..., Time: ..., Speaker: ..., Location: ..., Type: ..., Institute: ..., Host: ...' line (the list-page teaser truncates this for busy days). No price or address/district info anywhere - left null.
